# Third-party notices

Generated by `pnpm notices:generate` from the frozen dependency tree and reviewed
upstream texts in `licenses/`. Original Tandry source uses Apache-2.0; third-party
code retains its own license. This inventory deliberately includes JavaScript build
tooling as well as runtime dependencies. Listing a package does not mean its code is
in every artifact. Platform-only build executables are not redistributed here.

Package links below identify the exact upstream source archive. License text is
deduplicated by SHA-256; each package entry links to all of its supplied notices.
Preserve this file and emitted copyright comments when distributing the bundles.
Cloudflare-generated runtime declarations also retain their upstream headers.
